nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Ultra Facial Overnight Hydrating Mask with 10.5% Squalane

avis.texte: I am someone that has very dry & acne prone. I had SO much trouble finding something hydrating that also did not clog my pores. Once I started using this product about 2 years ago I simply could not turn back. I definitely use this product not really as the way its intended though. I apply this in the morning and let it soak into my skin all day and I also wear it over night. I personally love the consistency and it keeps my skin looking hydrated all day & when I wake up. I use the paired with the Kiehls moisturizer…. chefs kiss.

avis.titre: One of my favorite Kiehl's products
avis.texte: Im in my 60's. I have used this for decades ( since they first came out with this) This product has saved my barrier many times! Its calming, hydrating and makes my skin feel soft and hydrated. I use it about twice a week ( can be used more often) for me that's enough for it to make my skin feel less tight. Well worth the money.

So i've had this forever and I have super dry terrible skin all year round and I bought this as a super heavy night cream because I'm sensitive to Aquaphor around my eyes. So as an overnight cream, I didn't love this and can live without it, but I started using this as a cleansing balm to remove my makeup before I wash my face and holy moly it's a game changer. This is my all-time favorite cleansing balm. now my skin no longer feels stripped and super dry after washing.

Purchased this years ago and loved it. Then tried other face creams for nighttime that didn't quite do what this cream does. Purchased it again from Ulta, since I cannot find it on Kiehls actul website for some reason (kinda worrisome, I hope its not discontinued) but I LOVE this cream. For the price point it's unbeatable. I use it nightly and find it great for hydrating after tretinol/retinol/A313.
this makes my skin look SO good and doesnt clog my pores which is a plus!!

I have super breakout prone skin that gets incredibly dry on planes and in the winter. This is a must have for me. I use it a few times a week when my skin is dry and the normal daily moisturizer isnt enough. I see a lot of complaints about the texture/greasiness, so just want to share my own directions that work well for me. 1) get a nickel/quarter sized amount on my finger, 2) rub it with my other fingers for a few second to warm it up and get it softer, 3) dab onto my face and rub in gently focusing on especially dry spots, 4) keep massaging it in for about a minute until it feels mostly absorbed, 5) wait 30 minutes to put my face directly on my pillow. I have never had issues with it staining my pillows, though it did feel more "heavy" than I was used to the first few times I used it.

LOVE the Ultra Facial cream. However, during the cold, dry winter months it was not enough for my aging dry skin which is prone to eczema. Thought the Ultra Facial Overnight Hydrating Mask with Squalene would do the trick. It was extremely moisturizing, but I absolutely could not tolerate the odor of the cream. Returned, and will use the regular version and add an odorless squalene oil.

avis.titre: Not the best not the worst
avis.texte: I have acne prone combo skin type. I have seen and heard a lot of bad and good things about this mask and decided to try it. I have never done another overnight mask before. It felt immediately greasy once i put it on. I sleep on my side and move a lot in my sleep so i didnt know what to expect but my satin pillowcase is stained with this product. And i feel like i have bacon grease on my face when wake up. But it does do a very good job of moisturizing. And my skin after does feel really nice but the level of grease that i felt was not enough for me to ever buy this again.
I thought I ordered the wrong thing until I see the teviews now that the formaula was changed. Does not hydrate like the previous one. Cause skin irritation. Do bot recommend

This product is very heavy. I think that's the squalene part, but it is almost hard to move on the skin. I've personally been mixing mine with hyaluronic acid or a lighter moisturizer with mine for daily use. I will say - my apartment gets super dry in the winter and this is a good product for that. Definitely wouldn't use in the summer or humidity.

avis.titre: AMAZING if used the right way
avis.texte: If you have dry and/or mature skin, then you'll love this. If you slug, then you'll love this. If you're oily and don't like thick cream on your face at night or any other time, then this is NOT for you. I use this as my night cream, although I'm sure it can be a good masque too. Important to warm this product up on your finger tips for 5-10 sec and put on damp skin and it will spread easily. I put this over any serums I'm using (or neutrogena hydroboost) and it's an amazing nighttime moisturizer. It's thick and paste-like, but that's what i love about it. I put vaseline or cerave healing ointment over it and I'm ready for bed. I am on my 4th jar of this and I LOVE it. Worth the price IMO because of how long it lasts.

I was overjoyed with this product. I live in Colorado where the climate is very, very dry and my skin is also aware of this fact. The Kiel's Overnight mask is wonderful…it feels so rich and creamy and just melts into my skin. In the morning my skin fells totally rejuvenated. I never thought I would ever find a product to make my skin feel this good. I am hooked for life!

Following the reviews online, I purchase this product. Super expensive but so tiny. Tried it, expecting a smooth and hydrated skin as promised but it dried my face out. My skin is completely dried out, inflamed and I feel a burning around my eye area.

avis.titre: Not sure if I got a bad batch
avis.texte: I'm giving this three stars because it works great. But the smell is absolutely revolting. It says it's supposed to be fragrance free; mine smells like burning plastic. Maybe a QC issue? Going to try another tub because I really want this to work.

Now that winter is TRULY here, I've been on the hunt for a decent sleeping mask to hydrate and get my skin back to normal. I can't use anything too rich in the daytime as that means foundation will end up oxidizing as my skin can get quite oily. And with this I unfortunately just can't get past the consistency - it's very thick, almost like petroleum jelly and just sits on the surface of my skin. I'm used to sleeping on my side but once this is on I just dare not as it will end up all over my pillowcase. Have also tried using a really tiny amount but awoke to dry patches/flakiness which means it wasn't enough, yet any more is too much. Can't seem to find a middle ground with this one! Ingredients-wise there isn't a great deal in here, it's basic and simple stuff - good for those who have skin sensitivities and have to avoid many ingredients but not for those who are looking for a state of the art formulation, which this sure isn't! Definitely more suited to drier or very dehydrated skin types. I don't know how you can keep this on overnight. I've tried and it's like going to bed with butter smeared on my face, even when I just use a tiny but. I wake up with grease spots on my pillow and dog hair stuck to my face. Yuck.

This works so well, especially if you use prescription retinol this is a lifesaver. I am so shocked by the reviews for one star and people saying it smells bad. It's literally unscented it smells like unscented lotion are people used to super fragrancy things on their face? Literally overnight. My skin texture was so much better, I've been suffering from flakiness ever since starting prescription retinol's. You need to buy this. I used to slug with cerave￼, ultra healing balm, but was so sticky. It always left a film on my pillows, and this is like the perfect amount of moisture without all the sticky mess.

avis.titre: I want to love this but…
avis.texte: Too think for me, not calming at all. More like sealing your skin with Vaseline texture. Might be great for extra dry skin(I am combination skin late 30s) got it returned successfully and the lady at ulta was really helpful.

In terms of hydration this product is a 10. However, it's difficult to get out of the container as it has a wax-like consistency and you also have to be very careful because if this gets in your hair it's game over bc it turns greasy immediately. I found that my skin was a bit congested after use but so I don't use it every night but otherwise this is good and the container will last you forever
i miss the old formulation. it was a jelly-based formulation and didnt leave your face feeling oily like this one. was once my ride or die is now unused.

I have acne prone skin so I'm always having issues finding the right product but this will now be my go to night moisturizer I love what it's done for my skin and most importantly it didn't cause me to break out
The last overnight cream you'll ever need. My skin is so smooth and hydrated, not greasy BUT Zit smells like blood. If you can overlook that you won't regret it the smell dissipates wiggly quickly.
It luckily it's an overnight cream because smells like blood. Once you get get over the aroma ITS LIKE CHANGING. Your skin will feel like butter.

avis.titre: No results yet, weird texture, super oily
avis.texte: I was expecting this to be some kind of cream texture but it is a balm texture. When I first opened it I thought I had received a dried out product because it is hard in the container. It feels nice applying but once I lay down, I don't want to put my head on my pillow because my face looks and feels like it's covered in oil. I end up having to do other things around the house before laying down so it has time to absorb. Never had this problem with other night time masks. I won't be repurchasing. I'm a fan of many other Kiehls products but this one just isn't it for me
I am loving the difference in my skin..after just a few days..

I wear it every night and always leave my skin super soft. Especially been cold these days and helped me a lot. I had procedure and they informed no creams etc. the day of. The night before i put this in and woke up fresh. I didn't feel dry and my face was super soft

I had this as a sample and it's great. It doesn't dry like a "mask". It is a thick and smooth layering moisturizer. Some oily consistency and it feels like it is moisturizing adequately. Sometimes I put it on heavier than other times. I've only used it before bed. But I would use a light application of it if I wanted some good moisturizing and was just chilling around the house.
I wear it every night and it's really helped my skin retain its moisture love it!

I've only used this product twice and my daughter has used it once, but I put it on at night after my retinol product and wake up with my skin feeling smooth and full of moisture. I'm in my 40's and tend to have oily but dry skin. Really enjoying this product so far for a hydrated fresh face after the overnight treatment.

avis.titre: Don't know how I lived without it
avis.texte: I live in the northeast US and I have dry skin to begin with. I bought this from a recommendation on TikTok and I can't imagine life without it now. This is by far my new favorite nighttime face cream. If you have dry skin this is a MUST! It performs like a healing lotion and I don't wake up greasy. The texture is unique but I really really love and now prefer it.

Decided to give this mask a try after seeing it on Tik Tok. I was super excited because my skin has been extremely dry and flaky. Anyway… I ordered and it came in the mail, off the bat it felt great on my skin but then out of nowhere my skin started burning and itching like crazy. I had to wash it off immediately, next morning I woke up with a really bad rash on my face that lasted days.
